title: AIOS isolated execution transaction
description: Structured execution record for Phase X (AIOS-EXEC-DEMO-001). v1.2.0 adds operator_disclosures (binding vs packet-only, validation proof honesty).

review_slug.description: Folder name under reviews/, e.g. amd_2026_006.

source_repo.description: Remote clone URL or logical identity when known; may match product_repo_path for local-only operational runs.

product_repo_path.description: Concrete local filesystem path to the implementation repo (POSIX). Use not_applicable only for --no-git packet-only runs — not equivalent to a bound product clone; see operator_disclosures.

source_branch.description: Branch the execution derives from (e.g. main).

working_branch.description: Isolated feature branch or worktree branch name.

base_commit_sha.description: Commit SHA at start of isolated work.

head_commit_sha.description: Commit SHA after implementation (optional until run completes).

evidence_bundle_hash.description: SHA-256 or similar of merged KB bundle at run time.

architect_plan_hash.description: Hash of ARCHITECT_PLAN.md when fixed for this run.

ui_plan_hash.description: Hash of UI_PLAN.md when fixed for this run.

execution_scope.description: Short identifier for bounded scope (e.g. workspace_hub_readonly_v1).

allowed_surfaces.description: Routes, canvas ids, or component surfaces allowed to change.

required_visual_proofs.description: List of required captures (e.g. screenshot: /workspace hub).

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC when this transaction record was first created for the run.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC when this JSON was last written (single-run MVP: same as created unless re-run).

validation_started_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC when install/build/test began; null if skipped or failed before validation.

validation_completed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC when install/build/test finished; null if not reached.

artifacts.description: Paths relative to reviews/<slug>/execution/ (this file's directory).

failure_stage.description: First stage that failed when verification_status is failed; null when not failed or not applicable.

operator_disclosures.description: Honest machine-readable posture for reviewers; validation_skipped is a non-proof state, not soft success.

execution_lane_posture.description: packet_only: no product bind; failed_pre_worktree: git failed before usable worktree; worktree_bound: isolated worktree exists.

validation_proof_available.description: True only when npm install/build/test ran and all executed steps exited 0 (repo_truth_ok).

validation_non_proof_reason.description: Null when validation_proof_available is true; otherwise why there is no proof (e.g. skip_validation, validation_skipped).

visual_capture_automated.description: MVP runner does not automate screenshots.

human_review_status.description: Human judgment of the packet — separate from promotion_status (lifecycle). Populated by reviewers; runner seeds pending.

overrides_disclosed.description: True if any force/override path was used; must be documented in HUMAN_REVIEW_PACKET.md.

governance_repo_path.description: Path to aios-governing-docs (often '.' when cwd is repo root).

worktree_path.description: Absolute path to git worktree directory when isolation_mode is worktree.

isolation_mode.description: worktree: separate directory; branch_in_place: new branch in existing clone; none: packet only (--no-git).

runner_version.description: Semantic version string of the runner for reproducibility.
